title: Remove all IT companies from the list
description:
Remove all IT companies from the list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as clear_companies(companies), returning an empty list regardless of the input.
hints: Removing every item from a list leaves it empty.
You don't need to look at companies at all to know the result.
explanation: Whatever the input list contains, the result of removing every item from it is always the empty list.
